enactment.title: Marrow Creek Private Well Sampling Ordinance

fictionalProvenance.author: 0805_Claude_Opus55_S46INT
fictionalProvenance.attestation: Original fiction written for S46; no copied text.

sections.heading: Definitions
sections.text:
(a) In this ordinance, "well owner" means a person who owns land served by a private drinking water well in the County of Marrow Creek.
(b) In this ordinance, "certified laboratory" means a laboratory that the Health Officer lists as one that may test drinking water.

sections.heading: Sampling
sections.text:
(a) A well owner shall have the well water tested by a certified laboratory annually.
(b) A well owner shall send each test result to the Health Officer within fourteen (14) calendar days after the laboratory issues the result.
(c) A well owner may collect the water sample in person.

sections.heading: Health Officer duties
sections.text:
(a) The Health Officer shall notify the well owner within seven (7) calendar days after a test shows unsafe nitrate levels.
(b) The Health Officer may waive the sampling fee for a well owner who shows hardship.

sections.heading: Warnings
sections.text:
(a) A well owner shall post a boil-water warning at each tap within two (2) calendar days after such notice.
(b) Results of a retest shall be entered in the County well register.

sections.heading: Short title
sections.text: This ordinance may be cited as the Marrow Creek Private Well Sampling Ordinance.

amendments.instructionText: After Sec. 4, add a new Sec. 6, Sampling records: "A well owner shall keep a copy of each laboratory report at the well site."

section.heading: Sampling records
section.text: A well owner shall keep a copy of each laboratory report at the well site.

amendments.instructionText: In Sec. 3(a), strike "seven (7)" and insert "five (5)", with effect from August 1, 2026.
